description:
## Why this issue exists

The JMAP axum router in crates/mail/src/server.rs does not set standard security response headers. Add tower-http SetResponseHeadersLayer to build_router() with all six required headers. tower-http is already a dependency in crates/mail/Cargo.toml (features cors); add set_response_header feature. HSTS must only be sent when TLS is active.

## Acceptance criteria

- All six headers present on every JMAP response
- HSTS only emitted when TLS is configured
- Integration test asserts header presence and values
title: mail: add security response headers to JMAP axum router
